name: calibrate-health
description: Explore historical progress and start conversations about goals, calorie patterns, and weight trends from a private Calibrate account.

interface.shortDescription: Explore progress and chat with your data
interface.longDescription: Connect to your private Calibrate account with OAuth, then explore historical weight and calorie charts, compare periods, see your current goal, and start conversations about patterns and progress. Read-only analysis complements logging in the Calibrate app.
defaultPrompt: How am I progressing toward my weight goal?
Compare my progress this month with last month.
How do my weekday and weekend calorie patterns compare?
